mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX(ovs.option_value_id, '@', 2), '@', -1 ) AS optionTypeName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(ovs.option_value_id, '@', -1) AS optionValue FROM sku s JOIN option_value_sku ovs ON s.sku_id = ovs.sku_id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY optionTypeName
